correctness.rationale: The proof combines semisimplicity of algebraic isometries, a finite-orbit interpolation obstruction, an injective rotation intertwiner, orbit counting, and an explicit sharpness construction. The cubic consequence follows from the exact three-point spectrum.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Recent generalized tri-circular and algebraic weighted-composition literature was checked for equivalent statements. Two especially relevant older finite-spectrum/isometry-group articles were not inspected in full and remain the main residual coverage risk.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a sharp divisor law and spectral factorization for arbitrary algebraic surjective isometries of vector Hardy spaces and excludes an order-two symbol in the genuine cubic tri-circular setting.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
